# `core/memory/MappedBufferRing.js`

> **Source:** `engine/core/memory/MappedBufferRing.js`

MappedBufferRing.js - Zero-Copy Buffer Updates Provides a ring of pre-mapped buffers to avoid copies when uploading data to GPU. Standard writeBuffer() flow: JS TypedArray → Copy → C++ → Copy → GPU Process → Copy → GPU Buffer MappedBufferRing flow: JS writes directly to mapped memory → GPU Process → Copy → GPU Buffer (Saves one copy!) Based on: https://webgpufundamentals.org/webgpu/lessons/webgpu-optimization.html
